**Analysis summary:**
- **Test image features**: Dense white cottony mycelium covering a stem/crown area, with numerous small, round, tan/yellow-brown sclerotia (mustard-seed-sized bodies) scattered throughout
- **Southern_Blight**: White cottony mycelium on stems — matches the test image well
- **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot**: Shows large (1-2cm), irregular, black sclerotia — does NOT match (test image has tiny round tan ones)

The small, round, mustard-seed-sized sclerotia transitioning from white to tan/brown embedded in dense white mycelium at the stem/crown base is the textbook signature of *Sclerotium rolfsii* (Southern Blight).
